# 太上經戒-唐

**ID:** KR5c0184
**Custom ID:** ZB5c0175

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The text compiles Daoist disciplinary precepts from the *Tài shàng* 太上 (Lǎojūn) scriptural tradition. It belongs to the mature Táng-era codification of Daoist *jiè lǜ* 戒律 discipline, alongside the efforts of [金明七真](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%87%91%E6%98%8E%E4%B8%83%E7%9C%9F) Jīnmíng Qīzhēn (DZ 1125 *Sān dòng fèng dào kē jiè*) and others.

**Dating.** Táng. Dynasty: 唐.
